factual_allegations_input: Example Data Corp. used Acme Analytics software after the parties signed a written license agreement.

llm.factual_allegations:
FACTUAL ALLEGATIONS
Acme Analytics delivered the licensed software to Example Data Corp. under a written agreement.
Example Data Corp. used the software beyond the license scope and did not pay the agreed fees.
llm.introduction: This action arises from Example Data Corp.'s unauthorized use of Acme Analytics software.

Breach of Contract.description: Example Data Corp. breached the written software license agreement.

parties: Acme Analytics, Inc. is a California corporation.
Example Data Corp. is a corporation that entered the license agreement.
llm.jurisdiction: This Court has jurisdiction over this federal dispute.
llm.venue: Venue is proper in this district because the agreement was performed here.

causes_of_action: Example Data Corp. breached the written license agreement by exceeding the permitted use.
Acme Analytics performed its obligations and suffered damages as a result.
prayer_for_relief: WHEREFORE, Acme Analytics requests compensatory damages and injunctive relief.

factual_allegations_input: Metro Systems failed to deliver the data services promised in a written agreement with Hudson Research.

llm.factual_allegations:
FACTUAL ALLEGATIONS
Hudson Research entered a written data-services agreement with Metro Systems.
Metro Systems failed to deliver the promised data and retained Hudson Research's advance payment.
llm.introduction: This action concerns Metro Systems' failure to provide contracted data services.

Breach of Contract.description: Metro Systems breached the written data-services agreement.

parties: Hudson Research LLC is a New York limited liability company.
Metro Systems, Inc. is a corporation doing business in New York.
llm.jurisdiction: This Court has jurisdiction over the parties and subject matter.
llm.venue: Venue is proper in this district because material events occurred in New York.

causes_of_action: Metro Systems breached the written data-services agreement by failing to deliver the promised data.
Hudson Research suffered damages and is entitled to recover its advance payment.
prayer_for_relief: WHEREFORE, Hudson Research requests contract damages and restitution.
